verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no API for creating product or price catalog objects. EBANX's payment-link option is described as a no-code, dashboard-created link (ebanx-docs-13), not something provisioned via the API. The API-driven hosted checkout (ebanx-docs-12) and the AI agent integration guidance (ebanx-docs-28) are adjacent features and do not deliver agent-driven product, price and payment-link provisioning in one session.
